title: Clover 35B - naya AI model jo text ek saath likhta hai, free mein try karo
content:
ChatGPT jaisa har AI ek ek word karke likhta hai. Ye naya model AISA NAHI KARTA.
30 October ko DiffuSpace naam ki team ne Clover 35B A3B Preview release kiya.
Ye ek diffusion language model hai. And it is fully open source.
Aaj main samjhata hoon ki diffusion ka matlab kya hai, aur aap ise kaise use kar sakte ho.
Normal models are autoregressive. First word, then the second, then the third.
Diffusion model ka tareeka alag hai.
Wo ek poore hisse ko EK SAATH DRAFT karta hai, aur phir use baar baar refine karta hai.
Bilkul waise jaise image AI blur se clear photo banata hai.
That is why diffusion can be much faster.
Lekin sawaal ye hai, kya ye sach mein accha hai?
Is model mein total 35 billion parameters hain, lekin ek time pe SIRF 3 BILLION active hote hain.
Isse Mixture of Experts kehte hain. Poora dimaag nahi, sirf zaroori experts kaam karte hain.
It also has a thinking mode.
Team ka claim hai ki kai benchmarks pe ye same size ke autoregressive model Qwen 3.6 35B A3B se aage hai, aur kaafi tez generate karta hai.
Remember, these are the team's own numbers. TEST IT YOURSELF before you trust it.
Ab practical part. Ye APACHE LICENSE pe hai, matlab commercial use bhi possible hai.
Weights Hugging Face aur GitHub pe hain, aur SGLang aur llama.cpp mein inference support hai.
Maan lo aap ek support chatbot chalate ho, aur har reply mein 5 second lagte hain.
Agar diffusion model wahi quality tez de sake, toh user ka wait kam ho jayega.
So the smart move is simple. Take 20 real questions from your chatbot, run them on both models, and compare speed and quality side by side.
Mera take simple hai.
Right now it is only a Preview. Do not put it in production blindly.
Lekin agar diffusion models sach mein tez aur acche nikle, toh AI apps ka speed game badal sakta hai. Isko abhi seekhna smart move hai.
Comment CLOVER and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
